item.title: 🍂🌳 Fall Walk: Gus Harris Trail 🌳🍂 — Sun Oct 11, 11:00 AM
item.description:
Toronto Movies & Social Group - Celebrating 14 Years! # 🍂🌳 Fall Walk: Gus Harris Trail 🌳🍂
### A Hidden Ravine, Easy Walking & Great Conversation
Sometimes the best parts of Toronto are the ones most people drive right past.
Join us for a relaxed fall walk along the **Gus Harris Trail**, a quiet ravine trail that follows **Taylor-Massey Creek** through Scarborough and East York.
This isn't a challenging hike. It's an easy, mostly flat walk through one of Toronto's quieter green spaces, with plenty of time to enjoy the changing leaves, get some fresh air, and meet other people along the way.
We'll follow the creek, walk beneath the trees, and take our time enjoying the fall scenery. The goal isn't to race to the end of the trail. **It's to get outside, have some good conversations, and enjoy the company.**

item.description:

### A 90-Minute Halloween Ghost Walk Through Toronto's Haunted History
L ooking for something a little different this Halloween season?
Join us for a **guided ghost walk through the University of Toronto campus and its eerie surroundings**, exploring some of the stories, legends, and strange histories hidden in one of Toronto's oldest neighbourhoods. This isn't one of our regular walks where we're simply following a trail and enjoying the scenery.
**This is a curated storytelling experience.**
I've researched the locations, developed the route, and put together the stories specifically for this experience. We'll explore some of the darker corners of the university and surrounding neighbourhoods while uncovering the people, places, and legends that have given them their haunted reputations.

Celebrate Thanksgiving with a scenic fall walk through Toronto’s ravines as we make our way to **Evergreen Brick Works**. Along the way, enjoy the crisp autumn air, brilliant fall colours, and a peaceful escape from the city.
We’ll spend about **30 minutes exploring the Brick Works**, taking in its history, trails, and unique setting before heading back through **Mount Pleasant Cemetery** — one of Toronto’s largest and oldest cemeteries, with plenty of history and beautiful seasonal scenery. For those who’d like to keep the day going, we’ll finish with a cozy **Thanksgiving lunch at Swiss Chalet**.
Their seasonal special is expected to be around **$18.29 plus tax and tip** and includes stuffing, cranberry sauce, your choice of side, a roll, and a slice of pie — a pretty good way to finish a Thanksgiving walk! 🦃🥧
